recognize_zh: 骨髓幾乎被大量單一形態的異常前骨髓細胞取代，細胞質含紫紅色嗜苯胺顆粒，核呈腎形、折疊或雙葉，缺乏正常成熟的顆粒球，符合急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）。
features: Hypercellular aspirate replaced by a monotonous population of large abnormal promyelocytes
Moderate to abundant cytoplasm with fine to coarse azurophilic granules
Nuclei reniform, folded, or bilobed with fine chromatin
Scattered small dark erythroid precursors or lymphocytes; normal granulocytic maturation markedly reduced
Auer rods not clearly resolved at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and largely replaced by a monotonous population of large abnormal promyelocytes with moderate to abundant cytoplasm containing azurophilic granules and reniform, folded, or bilobed nuclei with fine chromatin. Normal maturing granulocytes are markedly reduced, with only scattered small erythroid precursors or lymphocytes. Auer rods cannot be resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent coagulation evaluation and confirmation of PML::RARA are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive promyelocytes have round nuclei with a Golgi hof and synchronous maturation, without bilobed nuclei or Auer rod bundles.
AML with maturation has agranular blasts with a spectrum of maturing granulocytes, and lacks sheets of hypergranular abnormal promyelocytes.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei but grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and are nonspecific esterase positive with weak MPO.
